args.title: Tamarack warehouse automation (2026) — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Tamarack blog post (blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse) and its companion piece (insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion):

- Pick rates rose 18% in 2026 with the adoption of autonomous carts.
- Integration took twice as long as planned.
- The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Source access: companion piece was unlocked via free registration using marcus.okafor@northwind.example.
